```python
# Unit test for function digitSum
def test_digitSum():
    # Empty string returns 0
    assert digitSum("") == 0
    # Lowercase characters contribute 0
    assert digitSum("abcde") == 0
    # Uppercase characters contribute their ASCII values
    assert digitSum("aAaaaXa") == 153  # ord('A')=65, ord('X')=88
    assert digitSum("abAB") == 131     # ord('A')=65, ord('B')=66
    assert digitSum("abcCd") == 67     # ord('C')=67
    assert digitSum("helloE") == 69    # ord('E')=69
    assert digitSum("woArBld") == 131  # ord('A')=65, ord('B')=66
    # Non-letter characters contribute 0
    assert digitSum(" ") == 0
    assert digitSum("123") == 0
    assert digitSum("a1b2C3") == 67    # only 'C' counts
    # Mixed content
    assert digitSum("You aRe a Very Smart Person") == 89 + 82 + 86 + 83 + 80  # Y+R+V+S+P = 400
    assert digitSum("ZzZz") == 90 + 90  # ord('Z')=90
    print("All tests passed!")

test_digitSum()
```

```python
def test_digitSum():
    # Empty string returns 0
    assert digitSum("") == 0

    # Single uppercase character
    assert digitSum("A") == 65

    # Single lowercase character contributes 0
    assert digitSum("a") == 0

    # Mixed case string
    assert digitSum("abAB") == 131  # 65 + 66

    # All uppercase
    assert digitSum("ABC") == 198  # 65 + 66 + 67

    # All lowercase
    assert digitSum("abc") == 0

    # String with digits (digits are not uppercase)
    assert digitSum("aA1") == 65

    # String with spaces
    assert digitSum(" A") == 65

    # Known example: "aBcDe" -> B(66) + D(68) = 134
    assert digitSum("aBcDe") == 134

    # Known example: "You ARE the best" -> Y(89) + A(65) + R(82) + E(69) = 305
    assert digitSum("You ARE the best") == 305

    # Special characters (not uppercase)
    assert digitSum("!@#") == 0

    # Unicode uppercase character
    assert digitSum("É") == 201

    # Longer mixed string
    assert digitSum("Hello World") == 72 + 87  # H + W = 159
```
